_about: Per-game color palettes for the stream overlay, built from the PlayStation games in Playstation/psn.json (247 trophy sets). Match a game like this: 1) look up its PlayStation code (games key) e.g. "CUSA02902_00" or "NPWR09395_00"; 2) otherwise look the lower-case name up in "byName"; 3) otherwise use "default". Each entry carries 16 named color roles (primary, secondary, tertiary, accent, accent2, border, border2, panel, panel2, text, muted, highlight, glow, shadow, ink, inkAccent), a 3-stop gradient, an 8-color swatch palette and an edge effect in the same shape as game-themes.json (same effect types, so it drops straight into game-themes.js). Nothing is ever drawn over the middle of the screen. Non-game Twitch categories get their own entry too: "category_music" (name Music, neon magenta/aqua, equalizer-style lights effect) is reachable through "categories".music and through the byName aliases music, dj, music production, live music, beats, lofi.
_usage: const t = await (await fetch('overlay/stream_overlay_theme.json')).json(); const key = String(gameName || '').toLowerCase().trim(); const g = t.games[commId] || t.games[t.byName[key]] || t.default; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(g.colors)) root.style.setProperty('--gt-' + k, v); // g.effect is ready for game-themes.js decorate(): same type/shape/dir/colors schema
